question: Which of the following states of India does NOT have a Panchayati Raj system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Panchayati Ra**j:

__
 
• It is a **system of local governance** in India where the administration of rural areas is entrusted to elected representatives at the village, block, and district levels.
 
• The **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992** established it as a constitutional amendment with the goal of fostering democracy at the local level.
 
• All states, with the **exception of Nagaland**, Meghalaya, and Mizoram, as well as all Union Territories, with the exception of Delhi, have the Panchayati Raj system.
 
• The Constitution's** Eleventh Schedule assigns **the Panchayati Raj bodies authority over as many as **29 functions.**
 
• The first committee to **suggest a three-tier system** for Panchayati Raj Institutions in India was the **Balwant Rai Mehta Committee.**
 
• The** L.M. Singhvi Committee** suggested giving Panchayati Raj Institutions **constitutional status.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 243** States the Definition of panchayats.

 
 

 Article 243A
 
 
Article 243A states about the Gram sabha.

 
 
 

 Article 243B
 
 
Article 243B states the constitution of panchayats.

 
 
 

 Article 243C
 
 
Article 243C States about the Composition of panchayats

 
 
 

 Article 243D
 Article 243D states the reservation of seats in panchayats.
 
 

 Article 243F
 Article 243F states about the disqualification of members of panchayats.
 
 

 Article 243G
 Article 243G states about the power authorities and responsibilities of panchayats.
 
 

 Article 243E
 
 
Article 243E states the duration of panchayats.

 
 
 

 Article 243H
 Article 243H states the power to impose taxes and fund the panchayats.
 
 

 Article 243I
 Article 243I states that the Constitution requires the finance committee to review the financial position of panchayats.
